title: lithocarpus nhatrangensis
intro: Lithocarpus nhatrangensis, commonly known as Vietnamese tan, is a plant species belonging to the beech family (Fagaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Vietnam, to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus nhatrangensis include various compounds like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
